about: lev_4_m2: Jonesy's tower task (ai/tower.rs). The mission's peasant_success_trigger 7001 (sent here at play frame 60, as if the tenth peasant were safe: [test] play_triggers, a hook built from 2026-10-16's testoracle.cpp) sends him off alone to the Glass Tower's marker 356; there 802 (the alarm, the second objective text, the 120 s countdown), the plant anim (eight bombs, 31.3 s) and the bomb loop. Roman stands at the start with his health held at its maximum (hold_health: the start's troops killed him in one original run, a roll), so nobody guards Jonesy: the original's dies at frame 7440 (5001), so the run stops at 6200 with the bomb loop running (the win path is the playtest tower_l4m2's). ENTER dismisses the briefing, the first objective text (~1 s after 7001) and the second (~1 s after the arrival; pressed every 40 frames round it). Compared exactly: companion.jonesy.mode (6 from frame 60, 7 from the arrival at ~3800), the triggers 7001 / 802 / 823 / 2, mission.objective, and Jonesy's position on the marker and through the plant anim (within 0.4 units)

known.companion.jonesy.pos: NAV1: on the walk (frames 200..3800) nav.rs's route takes the south corridor of the abbey where the original's nav mesh takes the north one, of the same length (2418 vs 2450 units); both arrive together and agree within 0.4 units on the marker and through the plant anim
known.companion.jonesy.health: T1: the original's Jonesy takes no damage during the plant anim (frames 3800..5680 at 500 in both original runs; the bomb loop's hits come after), the remaster's does (it killed him at ~5650 before the 2026-10-17 merge); before that the walk's hits are the troops' rolls (the whole level chases him in both)
